name: Domaine Huet Vouvray Cuvée Constance 2009
text:
## Domaine Huet Vouvray Cuvée Constance 2009 (500 ml)

**Story.** [Domaine Huet](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Domaine+Huet,+Vouvray,+France&t=k) was founded in 1928 by a Parisian bistro owner, Victor Huet, and later run with his son Gaston. Its three vineyards are [Le Haut-Lieu](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Le+Haut-Lieu,+Vouvray,+France&t=k), [Clos du Bourg](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Clos+du+Bourg,+Vouvray,+France&t=k) and [Le Mont](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Le+Mont,+Vouvray,+France&t=k) near [Vouvray](https://www.google.com/maps?q=Vouvray,+France&t=k) on the Loire. Cuvée Constance was first made in 1989, hand-picked grape by grape.

**Reviews.** The 2009 has several very high scores.
- Wine Enthusiast: 99 (June 2011).
- Wine Spectator: 98.
- John Gilman: 98+ (Jan 2011).
- David Schildknecht (robertparker.com, Aug 2010): 96.
- Chris Kissack (Winedoctor): 96.

CellarTracker community score, from your list: 95.1 (2009).

**Practical note.** Gilman suggested 2020–2100 and Schildknecht three or more decades, so it has decades left. Serve it well chilled, with no decanting. Roquefort or a tarte tatin would be a good match.

**Curious aside: sugar against acid.** At 11% alcohol and 150 grams of residual sugar per litre, the sweetness is held up by Chenin's naturally high acidity. The Vouvray streams encourage the noble rot (botrytis) behind these wines, and the vines grow on gravel and clay over tuffeau.

### From the history books
- 1928: Domaine Huet founded. See [this search](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Special:Search?search=Domaine+Huet+Vouvray&go=Go).
- 1936: Vouvray becomes an AOC (see [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC)).
- 1947: a Huet Vouvray is ranked No. 6 in Decanter's 2005 "100 Greatest Wines" (same article).

**Sources:** Jeb Dunnuck (subscriber site, checked directly), Uncorked, Falstaff, Farr Vintners, J.J. Buckley, Vinfolio, FRW, First Bottle, Kysela, Benchmark Wine, K&L, Whwc, Thatchers, Winewithseth, CellarTracker, Delectable, closdesspiritueux.com, and Wikipedia ([Châteauneuf-du-Pape AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ch%C3%A2teauneuf-du-Pape_AOC), [Nahe](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nahe_(wine_region)), [Vouvray AOC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vouvray_AOC), [La Clape](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massif_de_la_Clape), [Avignon Papacy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Avignon_Papacy), [Great French Wine Blight](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Great_French_Wine_Blight)).
